title: object.getSnapshot response result
description: Serialized property snapshot of one scene object. A DTO copy of generic values, not a reference into engine live memory.

kind.description: Optional generic object classification (free-form, not a NorvesLib type name).

properties.description: Serialized property entries for this object. May be empty.

components.description: Optional components attached to this object. Absent when the engine does not project components; an empty array means the object has none. Each entry carries the identifier to pass back to object.getSnapshot / object.setProperty for that component.

objectId.description: Identifier of this component as a scene object. Opaque to the editor.

kind.description: Generic component classification (free-form, not a NorvesLib type name).
